title: ANGRY FRUIT: THE GATHERING (Video Express cut)
style: Premium stylized 3D animated feature film still, original character design, anthropomorphic produce characters with photoreal macro food textures (real seed pits, pebbled skins, wax bloom, moisture), faces sculpted into the skin, slender plant-stem limbs, four-fingered hands, believable tailored cloth, cinematic lighting, anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, volumetric atmosphere, fine 35mm film grain. Serious, dramatic tone. 16:9. No humans, no text, no logos, no watermark.
keep: Keep every character's face, proportions, colors, wardrobe and props exactly as they are in the start image. Do not redesign anyone.

shots.name: Something Is Coming
shots.image: Complete darkness except for the faintest smoky reddish glow near the bottom of frame. Fine dust particles suspended in the dark. No characters visible. Deep blacks, volumetric haze, ominous.
shots.video: Hold mostly on darkness. Very slowly push forward through barely visible drifting smoke and dust. Three enormous distant impacts shake the frame: THUD... THUD... THUD. Dust jumps with each one; the last is strongest. Nothing is revealed. Build dread.

shots.name: Strawberry Knows
shots.image: Extreme macro close-up of {STRAWBERRY} Only his left eye and the skin around it fill the frame, the small pale pit-scar of the missing seed just above the eye. Fine dirt and battlefield dust on the skin. Hard red-orange rim light, deep shadow.
shots.video: Strawberry's eye is closed, then slowly opens as a distant rumble grows. The pupil focuses sharply on something off-camera. Tiny muscles around the eye tense. Faint camera vibration from distant marching. Slow push-in.

shots.name: Produce City
shots.image: Enormous establishing shot of a produce civilization at night: an old produce market grown into dense urban neighborhoods, giant greenhouse architecture, orchards woven through the streets, irrigation canals, lantern-lit stalls and towering organic structures. Tiny produce citizens move through the streets far below. Moon-blue light, warm amber windows, distant mountains and farmland. Huge scale, atmospheric haze.
shots.video: Start high above the city and slowly fly forward and down while hundreds of tiny lights and citizens move below. It feels peaceful. Halfway through, birds burst out of the far fields and a tremor runs through everything: hanging signs sway, canal water ripples. End facing the dark horizon.

shots.name: The Herd
shots.image: Epic ultra-wide shot at night. Beyond dark farmland the Herd emerges through thick smoke against hard orange backlight: {PORK TRIBE} {BEEF TRIBE} Banners, crude iron war machines, hundreds of distant soldiers. Every figure is a backlit silhouette; no face, eye or mouth is readable. Dust rises behind thousands of marching feet. Imposing and organized.
shots.video: The Herd advances toward camera in heavy synchronized steps that shake the ground. Banners whip. Smoke rolls between the silhouettes. One colossal Beef silhouette looms out of the smoke and sinks back into it. The camera slowly pulls back as they come. Faces stay in black the whole time.

shots.name: Three Viewers
shots.image: {STRAWBERRY} He sits in his pirate-radio livestream studio inside a root cellar: earthen walls, a cluttered desk with a vintage microphone, three mismatched monitors, maps, photographs, a red-string evidence board and hand-drawn diagrams of troop movements beyond the pasture. Homemade but obsessive. A bare tungsten bulb and monitor glow, deep shadow.
shots.video: Strawberry jabs a finger at the map on his evidence board, swings back to the livestream monitor, reads the viewer count and freezes. Flat, insulted disbelief. He says quietly: "Three viewers?" A distant THUD swings the bare bulb above him. Camera holds nearly still.

shots.name: The Call
shots.image: {STRAWBERRY} He stands at the head of a battered table in the root cellar, now an emergency war room. A large hand-drawn map of Produce Territory covers the table. Empty chairs all around. He points hard at a circled location. Single overhead bulb, red warning glow, deep shadows.
shots.video: Strawberry rolls the map open across the table with one hard push. The camera tracks the map and tilts up to his face. He plants both hands on the table and says: "Stop arguing. Start surviving." Hold on him for half a second.

shots.name: The Mortician
shots.image: {WATERMELON} He stands inside an elegant produce funeral home beside a closed casket sized for produce, back half-turned to the doorway. Strawberry waits small in the doorway behind him, out of focus. Moody warm lamplight. Dark comedy played completely straight.
shots.video: Watermelon slowly pulls off one long black glove, finger by finger, without turning around. He says: "Everybody ends up here." Then, unhurried, he looks back toward the doorway. Slow camera push.

shots.name: The Lawyer
shots.image: {AVOCADO} He walks briskly down wide stone courthouse steps in Produce City, reading paperwork. Strawberry waits at the bottom of the steps. Late afternoon light, long shadows.
shots.video: Avocado comes down the stairs reading paperwork and never slows. Strawberry steps into his path and says: "I need a war lawyer." Avocado stops dead and looks at him over his glasses. Camera tracks backward with Avocado, then settles.

shots.name: The Bondsman
shots.image: {CORN} He stands outside a gritty bail-bonds storefront in Produce City at sunset, hand still on the door he just locked. Strawberry approaches from frame left. Western framing, low warm sun, dust in the air.
shots.video: Corn turns from the door, sees Strawberry coming and lets out a long breath. Slowly he tips the flat brim of his hat down and says: "I know people." Camera pushes in on Corn.

shots.name: The Bouncer
shots.image: {BROCCOLI} He stands at the velvet rope outside an upscale Produce City nightclub at night, neon light, produce patrons waiting in line. Strawberry stands beside him, tiny by comparison.
shots.video: Broccoli lifts an unruly patron out of frame with one arm, no effort at all. He slowly turns his head to Strawberry. Silence. He cracks his taped knuckles. Cut on the crack.

dialogue.line: How do you feel about Beef?

shots.name: The Dealer
shots.image: {CHILI} He stands proudly in a questionable used-vehicle lot full of strange produce-world automobiles, string pennants overhead, bright lot lights against a darkening sky. Strawberry inspects a battered armored vegetable truck beside him.
shots.video: Chili slaps the hood of the battered armored truck. A panel falls off. Strawberry stares at him. Chili says: "That ain't structural... mostly." The engine starts smoking. Quick punch-in on Chili.

shots.name: I Brought Myself
shots.image: {POTATO} He stands heroically in the doorway of the root-cellar war room, backlit through smoke, plainly the least qualified warrior present. Inside, Strawberry, Lemon and Broccoli turn to look at him.
shots.video: The door bursts open through smoke. Potato steps in and announces: "I brought myself." Silence. His enormous earnest grin does not move at all. Camera holds.

shots.name: Repossession
shots.image: {CARROT} He is behind the wheel of {CARROT'S TRUCK} The truck drifts sideways through a Produce City street mid-battle, sparks off the rear bumper, smoke and debris. Low camera at wheel height. No gore.
shots.video: Carrot yanks the wheel and drifts the flatbed around the corner, sparks spraying. Camera tracks alongside at wheel height. He shouts: "REPOSSESSION!" An explosion goes up safely behind him as he accelerates away.

shots.name: Street Committee
shots.image: {GRAPES} All seven charge down a sloped street together in improvised battle gear, Gerald the green one a half step behind. The battlefield burns far behind them. Low-angle wide lens. They are arguing as they run.
shots.video: The seven Grapes charge downhill and instantly disagree about which way to go. Overlapping shouts: "LEFT!" "RIGHT!" "SHUT UP, GERALD!" They collide, bounce, recover and keep running, still arguing. Handheld chase camera.

shots.name: Fruit or Vegetable
shots.image: Massive heroic wide shot at dawn before the gates of Produce City. {STRAWBERRY} He stands elevated at the front, seen from behind and slightly to the side. Nearby: Watermelon, Avocado, Corn, Broccoli, Chili, Banana, Lemon, Potato, Pumpkin and the Grapes. Beyond them, hundreds of produce warriors fill the distance: {CELERY} {PINEAPPLES} {ONIONS} {BLUEBERRIES} Smoke, banners, sunrise.
shots.video: Slow crane up from behind Strawberry to reveal hundreds upon hundreds of allies. He says: "Tomorrow they won't ask whether you're fruit... or vegetable." The crowd goes silent. Wind catches the banners.

dialogue.line: Tomorrow they won't ask whether you're fruit... or vegetable.

shots.name: How You Want to Be Cooked
shots.image: Two Herd commanders standing side by side in smoke, framed from the chest up against hard orange battlefield backlight: {PORK TRIBE} {BEEF TRIBE} Both are pure silhouettes, faces lost in black, only tusk and horn edges catching ember light. Their armies fill the blurred background.
shots.video: Slow push toward the two silhouettes. The Beef commander lowers his enormous horns a fraction. Steam pours from their breath. Smoke rolls across their armor. Their faces stay in black. Massive bass impact at the end.

dialogue.line: They'll just ask... how you want to be cooked.

shots.name: Stay Angry
shots.image: {STRAWBERRY} He stands at the front of the united produce army on devastated farmland, facing the distant Herd. Broccoli, Corn and Watermelon flank him. He looks small against the armies and completely determined. Sunrise behind the produce army.
shots.video: Start close on Strawberry's face. He whispers: "Stay angry." He charges. Broccoli, Corn and Watermelon follow, and within a second the whole army erupts behind them. Camera races backward ahead of hundreds running at the lens.

shots.name: Collision
shots.image: Ultra-wide battlefield at sunrise: the produce alliance charges from the left, the Herd charges from the right as backlit silhouettes, moments before they meet. Dust and banners, gigantic scale. No impact yet, no gore.
shots.video: Both armies sprint at each other while the camera races sideways across the field. Just before they collide, smash cut to black. Do not show the impact.

shots.name: Everybody Has Beef
shots.image: Close-up hero portrait of {STRAWBERRY} Battle-worn and dirty but unhurt, warm firelight behind him, embers in the air, shallow depth of field.
shots.video: Very slow push in. Embers drift behind him. He looks straight into the lens and says calmly: "Everybody has beef." His face stays completely still. Cut to black.

shots.name: Title
shots.image: Dark smoky background, red, orange, green and yellow light bleeding faintly through thick smoke, floating embers. The center is empty, kept clear for a title added later. Absolutely no generated text or letters.
shots.video: Move slowly through dark smoke as embers drift toward the lens. Bass impact at the start. The smoke parts slightly in the center, leaving clean empty space. No text.

shots.name: Shut Up, Gerald
shots.image: Three members of {GRAPES} Gerald the green grape in the middle, two purple grapes on either side, standing alone in smoky darkness under a soft spotlight. One purple grape looks irritated, the other exhausted. Gerald looks like he has a point.
shots.video: Hold awkwardly on the three Grapes for a beat. Gerald says quietly: "Technically... we don't." The irritated purple grape snaps his head toward him. The third shakes his head. Hard cut to black.
